💚 Pass On a Tool

Have a tool you no longer need?

Pass it on to Elizabethan Hall and help make a difference in our local community.

Your unwanted tool could help a neighbour complete a job without having to buy equipment they may only use once or twice.

By passing on a tool, you are helping to support local people, support Elizabethan Hall, reduce waste and landfill, and help people build practical skills.

Important: If Elizabethan Hall accepts your tool, ownership passes to Elizabethan Hall. The Hall will then prepare it and make it available through Toolshare.

How it works

  1. Tell us about your tool — complete the form below.
  2. Elizabethan Hall reviews it — we decide whether it is suitable for Toolshare.
  3. We contact you — if accepted, we'll email you to confirm the donation and arrange a drop-off date/time or collection if required.
  4. Ownership passes to the Hall — once accepted, the tool becomes the property of Elizabethan Hall.
  5. Your tool helps someone locally — it can then be borrowed through Toolshare.

Your membership

How will you use Toolshare?

Local membership
Newbiggin Toolshare is a local community scheme. We ask for your address so we can confirm that you live within the area covered by the scheme. You may be asked to provide suitable proof of address when your membership is approved. You won't normally need to provide it again when collecting tools.

For example, a driving licence, council tax letter, utility bill or other official document showing your name and address. The live system will securely handle this document.

💳 Secure payment with SumUp
Your card details are entered directly with SumUp. Elizabethan Hall and Toolshare do not store your full card number, expiry date or security code.

After your membership details have been completed, you will be taken to the secure SumUp payment page for your chosen membership.

Payment at collection

🎒 What to bring when collecting

To keep collection quick and simple, please have:

  • 📱 Your booking confirmation — on your phone is fine.
  • 🪪 Photo ID if this is your first collection — such as a driving licence or passport.
  • 🔑 Your Toolshare membership details.

The person collecting must be the named member on the booking, unless Toolshare has agreed an alternative arrangement in advance.

Once your membership has been verified, you won't normally need to provide proof of address each time you collect a tool.

1️⃣ Book your tool

Choose the tool you need, select your dates and submit your booking. Wait for your booking to be confirmed before travelling to the Hall.

2️⃣ Collect it

Bring your booking confirmation and the details needed to identify your account. A member of the Toolshare team will check the tool out to you.

3️⃣ Check before you leave

Make sure you have the correct tool and any accessories included with the booking. If you notice damage or a problem, tell the Toolshare team before taking it away.

4️⃣ Use it safely

Follow the manufacturer's instructions and any safety guidance provided by Toolshare. Some equipment may require appropriate experience or additional guidance.

5️⃣ Return it on time

Bring the tool back to Elizabethan Hall by the agreed return time. Please don't leave tools outside or unattended.

6️⃣ We check it back in

We'll check the tool when it is returned and record it as available again for the next member.

Need more time?
If you need the tool for longer, contact Toolshare before your return time. We'll try to extend the booking where possible, provided another member isn't waiting for the tool.

🔄 Sharing means looking after it

Every tool in Toolshare is there because someone has made it available to the community. Please treat it with the same care you would expect someone to show your own equipment.

Collect it. Use it. Return it. Keep it in the community.

Toolshare Terms

Simple pilot terms

Toolshare is designed to make borrowing straightforward while protecting the people and equipment taking part.

  • The daily hire fee is shown when you choose a tool.
  • The tool must be returned by the agreed return date and in the condition it was received, allowing for normal reasonable use.
  • For community-owned tools, the donor remains the owner of the item.
  • For each item, Toolshare records an donation confirmation supplied by the donor. This figure is kept as part of the Toolshare record and is not displayed as part of the normal borrowing price.
  • If an item is not returned, the borrower agrees to reimburse the donor at the donation confirmation recorded for that item.
  • Safety information and any experience requirements shown for a tool must be followed.
  • Membership eligibility and local address may be checked when joining Toolshare. After verification, members will not normally be asked to provide proof of address for every collection.

These are pilot terms and will be reviewed as the scheme develops.

About Newbiggin Toolshare

DON’T BUY IT. SHARE IT.

Newbiggin Toolshare is a community tool-sharing service operated by Elizabethan Hall. It helps local people access useful tools without having to buy equipment they may only need occasionally.

Our aims

  • 💚 Support our local community.
  • ♻️ Reduce waste and landfill by keeping useful tools in use.
  • 🛠️ Help people take on DIY, repairs and practical projects.
  • 🏛️ Support Elizabethan Hall and its community work.

How Toolshare works

Join → Find a tool → Book it → Collect → Use it → Return it

Members choose a tool, select their collection and return dates, and see the hire cost before confirming the booking.

Membership

Membership is annual:

  • Bronze — £10 — everyday tools
  • Silver — £20 — wider power and specialist range
  • Gold — £30 — widest range and higher-value specialist tools where appropriate

Hire charges are separate from the annual membership fee. Toolshare membership is for people aged 18 or over.

Tool hire

Each tool has its own daily hire charge. The website calculates the total from the selected dates.

Tool hire is paid at Elizabethan Hall when the tool is collected. We accept cash or card. Payment is taken before the tool leaves the Hall.

Collection and return

Customers receive a Toolshare Collection Pass with their booking details and a QR code. At the Hall, staff can use the pass to find the booking and record collection.

When the tool is returned, staff can find the same booking and record the return.

Pass On a Tool

If you have a tool you no longer need, you can offer it to Elizabethan Hall through Pass On a Tool.

The Hall decides whether the tool is suitable. If accepted, ownership passes to Elizabethan Hall. The Hall can then prepare the tool for use and make it available through Toolshare.

We may arrange a drop-off or collection by email.

Our rules

  • Use tools safely and only for their intended purpose.
  • Only use equipment you are competent and confident to use.
  • Do not pass a Toolshare tool on to another person.
  • Return tools on the agreed date and in a clean, usable condition.
  • Report damage, loss or faults to Elizabethan Hall as soon as possible.
  • Elizabethan Hall may refuse or withdraw a loan where necessary for safety, misuse or protection of Hall property.

Safety

Toolshare provides access to equipment; it does not replace appropriate training or instruction. Members are responsible for using tools safely and following the manufacturer's instructions. If you are unsure how to use a tool safely, please ask before using it.

Your information

Elizabethan Hall uses the information provided to manage Toolshare membership, bookings and the service. We collect only information needed for these purposes.

We do not sell members' information or provide it to other organisations for marketing. Members' personal contact details are not made available to other Toolshare members. Information may be shared where necessary to provide the service, meet legal requirements, or protect members, volunteers and Hall property.

Payment security

Membership payments are processed securely by SumUp. Elizabethan Hall does not store members' full card number, expiry date or security code.

Tool hire payments are made face-to-face at Elizabethan Hall by cash or card.

About Elizabethan Hall

Newbiggin Toolshare is operated by Elizabethan Hall as part of its community work. Membership and hire income helps support the running, maintenance and development of the Toolshare service and the wider community facilities.
